observations: Single photo shows the inside of a cargo van with a disassembled 3-wheel vehicle loaded in it.
Red and black bodywork panels are visible, consistent with a sport trike/motorcycle shape.
A wheel/tyre assembly is detached and lying separately from the main frame.
Another wheel or suspension component is also separated and visible near the van's rear doors.
No brand name, model plate, VIN, or any readable text is visible anywhere in the photo.
The vehicle appears to be in a partially stripped or disassembled state, not ready to ride.

Photo 0 shows a red/black trike shape consistent with a Can-Am Ryker style, but no badge, logo, or model marking is legible to confirm it is genuinely a Ryker.
No customs paperwork or receipt shown in any photo.
A detached wheel/tyre is visible in photo 0 but tread condition and brand cannot be clearly judged from this angle.

risks.proof: Photo or video of the trike fully reassembled and standing on its three wheels.

risks.risk: No visible brand/model plate or VIN to confirm it is an actual Can-Am Ryker versus a generic or replica trike.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of VIN plate, frame number, or brand badge.

risks.risk: Engine/mechanical functionality cannot be assessed from a static photo of disassembled parts.

risks.risk: Customs/duty and import documentation claims cannot be checked remotely.
risks.proof: Clear photo of customs duty certificate or import papers with matching chassis/VIN number.

risks.risk: Tyre condition and age cannot be confirmed as 'brand new' from the angle shown.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of any VIN plate, frame number, or brand badge on the trike.
Photo or video of the trike fully reassembled and standing on its three wheels.
Video of the engine starting and the trike being ridden or moved under its own power.
Clear photo of customs/duty documents showing a matching chassis number.
Close-up photos of tyre tread and DOT date codes on all three tyres.
response.reason: The single photo shows a disassembled trike with no readable brand, model, or VIN, so the seller's central claim (that this is a Ryker with full duty paid) cannot even be priced at a worst-case level without first confirming identity and completeness.
